The '''Utilities Squad''' was a division of [[the Young]] led by [[Taun]], responsible for restoring power and heat to the citizens of [[Zehava]] after the cessation of hostilities following the [[Battle of Zehava (Young–Elders War)|Battle of Zehava]].
